title: Launch.json Generator From Playground Registry
description:
Turn the currently hand-maintained `.vscode/launch.json` into a generated artifact so the ~175 per-plugin dev-launcher entries (of 215 total) can never drift from the plugin/playground registry again. Part of the Crate Consolidation & Plugin Taxonomy Restructure W0 mechanism-prep wave (see master ticket .🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md, plan section ".vscode/launch.json | Generate it").

Scope:
1. Split .vscode/launch.json into a hand-maintained seed (.vscode/🧩️launch.seed.jsonc) holding everything not mechanically derivable from the plugin/playground registry (keyboard/mouse shortcuts, bespoke tooling launchers, wgpu-native launchers, fixture-variant launchers, build/publish groups, the one compound config) plus a devLaunchers metadata table (per-playground-variant name/command/order/env/serverReadyAction templates with {PORT} tokens).
2. Add a new generator file 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/🖥️launch.ts (sibling to the owned registry script.ts, imports generatePlaygroundRegistry read-only) that combines the seed + registry ports into the full launch.json text, runnable as `bun 🖥️launch.ts generate` / `generate --check`.
3. Verify byte-identical regeneration of today's file (acceptance test) and zero git diff.

Ownership: .vscode/launch.json, .vscode/🧩️launch.seed.jsonc, and the new 🖥️launch.ts file only. Do not edit 📇️registry/📜️script.ts or root 📜️script.ts (owned by other W0 agents this wave).
summary: Made .vscode/launch.json a generated artifact. Split today's 215 configurations + 1 compound into a new hand-maintained seed (.vscode/🧩️launch.seed.jsonc: 137 verbatim entries + the compound + a `devLaunchers` metadata table for 42 playground variants) and a new generator (🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/📇️registry/🖥️launch.ts) that combines the seed with generatePlaygroundRegistry() ports to emit the other 78 react/wgpu dev-launcher entries. `bun 🖥️launch.ts generate --check` confirmed byte-identical regeneration of the original file before any write; `generate` then wrote it and `git diff --stat .vscode/launch.json` showed zero changes. Did not touch 📇️registry/📜️script.ts or root 📜️script.ts (owned by other W0 agents). Flagged for follow-up: root-level `verify gate` wiring for freshness checking, and a pre-existing bug where playbook's two launch entries use lowpoly's ports instead of its own registry ports (preserved byte-for-byte in the seed rather than silently fixed).
